svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print open side up, 168 x 76 mm, 2 mm walls, 2.5 mm floor; supports only

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the three saddle ribs, which follow the cuff's curve.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside, from the elbow end: two cell saddles, four tray posts, the stop

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: button well, the motor cradle, the 3 mm motor bulkhead, the idler

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: posts and shelves, then the front wall with eight exit and screw holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bulkhead: 8 mm shaft holes 13.5 mm each side of centre, 14 mm above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: floor; 3.4 mm holes 8.5 mm either side of each, countersunk at the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Push in heat-set inserts (M3, 5 mm): six in the rib bosses from below,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four in the lid bosses from above.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: ribs sit on the cuff shell (six M3 screws); front wall carries the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: anchor block (four M3 screws from inside); lid on the wall tops.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a motor slides into the cradle and its face sits flat on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bulkhead; a 3 mm pin drops into each idler post.
